message.content:
抱歉，我目前沒有直接啟動引擎的功能。不過您可以透過顯示車輛狀態來查看油量與電池資訊。請問您想先查看哪一項？

- 若要查看油量：`displayCarStatus(option="fuel")`
- 若要查看電池狀態：`displayCarStatus(option="battery")`

如果您還需要其他協助（例如調整空調、設定導航等），隨時告訴我！

There's no direct function to start engine. But we can maybe set engine? There is no function for starting engine. No function to start engine. So we cannot do that. We can respond that we can't start engine. Maybe we can ask if they want to check fuel level via displayCarStatus? That function displays status of vehicle based on option: fuel, battery, etc. So we can call displayCarStatus with option "fuel" or "battery". But the user specifically wants to start engine. We can say we cannot start engine but can display fuel and battery status. Let's respond accordingly.
